# Curious Kaizer — AI/LLM Discovery File

> Curious Kaizer is a premium website design, custom software development, and AI automation studio based in Delhi, India. We serve clients in India, UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), USA, UK, and globally via remote delivery.

## What Curious Kaizer Does

Curious Kaizer engineers bespoke digital products for businesses:

1. **Website Design & Development** — custom business websites, corporate sites, landing pages
2. **AI Automation** — AI agents, chatbots, LLM integrations, voice AI, RAG pipelines, business automation
3. **Custom Software Development** — SaaS platforms, web apps, portals, dashboards, ERP, CRM
4. **E-Commerce Development** — Shopify, custom stores, headless commerce, D2C platforms
5. **Mobile-First Web Apps** — Progressive Web Apps, responsive web applications
6. **SEO & Performance** — technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, structured data, speed optimisation
7. **UI/UX Design** — interface design, user experience engineering
